evidence.quote: before she decides on next year's tools
Could you tell me how to export everything we have in Ledgerline?
Our renewal is on 15 December, so it would help to know what's possible in the next couple of weeks.
You can export your invoices, clients and payments at any time, on every plan, from Settings → Data → Export.
Choose what to include and a date range; the default is everything since your account was created.
Each type downloads as its own CSV file.
Tick "Include invoice PDFs" to add a PDF of every invoice in a zip file.
File attachments on invoices are not included in exports; download them from each invoice.
Exports of more than 5,000 invoices are prepared in the background and emailed to you as a download link within 24 hours.
The API is available on the Growth and Scale plans.
The API can read your full history of invoices, clients and payments, with no date limit.
Each invoice's PDF is available from the invoice's pdf endpoint.
An account owner creates API keys in Settings → Developers.
The API reference is at developers.ledgerline.example.
If you're reviewing your tools before a renewal, your account manager can walk you through your options.

draft:
Hi Aisha,

Yes, you can export all of it yourself at any time, on every plan, from Settings → Data → Export. Choose what to include and a date range; the default is everything since your account was created. Each type (invoices, clients and payments) downloads as its own CSV file.

Tick "Include invoice PDFs" to add a PDF of every invoice in a zip file. File attachments on invoices are not included in exports, so those need to be downloaded from each invoice. Exports of more than 5,000 invoices are prepared in the background and emailed to you as a download link within 24 hours.

On the API: it's available on the Growth plan, so you have access to it. It can read your full history of invoices, clients and payments with no date limit, and each invoice's PDF is available from the invoice's pdf endpoint. An account owner creates API keys in Settings → Developers, and the reference is at developers.ledgerline.example.

Since your new finance director is reviewing tools ahead of your 15 December renewal, your account manager can also walk you through your options. Just let us know if you'd like us to set that up.

Best,
Ledgerline Support
agentNote: The renewal is 15 December and a new finance director is reviewing next year's tools, so this may be an early churn signal; consider looping in the account manager. The help center doesn't say whether client exports include contact details, so check that before confirming it.
